text: The ___ test compares the ratio of nonsynonymous to synonymous polymorphism within a species (Pn/Ps) to the same ratio for divergence between species (Dn/Ds) to detect departures from neutral evolution.
explanation: The McDonald-Kreitman test contrasts within-species polymorphism (Pn/Ps) with between-species divergence (Dn/Ds); under strict neutrality these ratios should be equal, and an excess of nonsynonymous divergence signals positive selection, quantified by the neutrality index α. This differs from dN/dS branch or site models (PAML, HyPhy), which use divergence data alone without polymorphism data.
